💡 How RideNow&PayLater Works
1️⃣Complete Loan KYC with your real ID details
2️⃣Drive a minimum of 50 km within 3 months to qualify
3️⃣Your loan limit scales with km driven — more km = higher limit
4️⃣Book rides now, pay later from your balance
5️⃣Repayment is auto-deducted from future rides or wallet
